items.headline: The Baloch Liberation Army (BLA) has announced the appointment of Senior Commander Rehman Gul, alias Mureed, as its new Commander-in-Chief, succeeding Bashir Zeb Baloch
items.excerpt: 🇵🇰⚡ The Baloch Liberation Army (BLA) has announced the appointment of Senior Commander Rehman Gul, alias Mureed, as its new Commander-in-Chief, succeeding Bashir Zeb Baloch. According to a statement issued by BLA spokesperson Jeeyand Baloch, the appointment was unanimously approved by the organisation's Senior Command Council and endorsed by its leadership and commanders. Rehman Gul previously served as a member of the Senior Command Council and commander of the Majeed Brigade.
